# NEW 2026-11-23 v19.0 Module 19.0-B: 6 Zero-Override Custom Map Modes (oe_ux2_mm_*) (oe_ux2_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v190_mapmodes_ledger.py; edit the generator, not this file.

@oe_ux2_zoom_flatmap_far = 21
@oe_ux2_zoom_flatmap = 12
@oe_ux2_zoom_near = 2
@oe_ux2_edge_color_mult = 0.7
@oe_ux2_flat_alpha_inside = 0.75
@oe_ux2_flat_alpha_outside = 1
@oe_ux2_flat_width = 0.25
@oe_ux2_flat_color_mult = 0.9
@oe_ux2_flat_edge_width = 0.03
@oe_ux2_flat_edge_sharpness = 0.00
@oe_ux2_flat_edge_alpha = 1.0
@oe_ux2_flat_before = 0.5
@oe_ux2_flat_after = 0.5
@oe_ux2_far_width = @[oe_ux2_edge_color_mult*1.25]
@oe_ux2_far_edge_width = @[oe_ux2_flat_edge_width*1.5]

# 1. Phoenix Destiny & Core Mission Realms
oe_ux2_mm_phoenix_destiny = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/map_modes/great_powers.dds"
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { is_human = yes } }
				if = { limit = { is_core_of = owner } value = define:NMapColors|HRE_EMPEROR_COLOR }
				else = { value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MID }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { oe_ux2_is_destiny_completed_trigger = yes } }
				value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_GUARANTEE_COLOR
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_variable = oe_msn_active_pack } }
				value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_ROYAL_MARRIAGE_COLOR
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { oe_ux2_is_destiny_power_trigger = yes } }
				if = { limit = { is_core_of = owner } value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_ALLIANCE_COLOR }
				else = { value = define:NMapColors|QUEUED_MAP_COLOR }
			}
			else = { value = define:NMapColors|MAP_ANTAGONISM_NO_RISK }
		}
		else = { value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_OUT_OF_RANGE_COLOR }
	}
	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				is_capital = yes
				owner = { oe_ux2_is_destiny_power_trigger = yes }
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_PROXIMITY_BUILDING
		}
	}
	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_human = yes } }
			value = OE_UX2_MM1_TT_PLAYER
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_ux2_is_destiny_completed_trigger = yes } }
			value = OE_UX2_MM1_TT_DONE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { has_variable = oe_msn_active_pack } }
			value = OE_UX2_MM1_TT_ACTIVE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_ux2_is_destiny_power_trigger = yes } }
			value = OE_UX2_MM1_TT_POWER
		}
		else = { value = OE_UX2_MM1_TT_OTHER }
	}

	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM1_PLAYER" color = define:NMapColors|HRE_EMPEROR_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM1_DONE" color = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_GUARANTEE_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM1_ACTIVE" color = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_ROYAL_MARRIAGE_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM1_POWER_CORE" color = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_ALLIANCE_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM1_POWER_FRONT" color = define:NMapColors|QUEUED_MAP_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM1_CAP" color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_PROXIMITY_BUILDING }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM1_OTHER" color = define:NMapColors|MAP_ANTAGONISM_NO_RISK }

	small_map_names = location
	medium_map_names = country
	large_map_names = country

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = country

	flatmap_behaviour = Always
	use_fow = no

	category = geopolitics
	index = 2

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = @oe_ux2_zoom_near
		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = @oe_ux2_far_width
		gradient_color_mult = @oe_ux2_flat_color_mult
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_sharpness
		edge_alpha = 0
		edge_color_mult = 0
		before_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_before
		after_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_after
	}
	flatmap_gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = @oe_ux2_zoom_flatmap
		gradient_alpha_inside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_inside
		gradient_alpha_outside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_outside
		gradient_width = @oe_ux2_flat_width
		gradient_color_mult = @oe_ux2_flat_color_mult
		edge_width = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_width
		edge_sharpness = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_sharpness
		edge_alpha = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_alpha
		edge_color_mult = @oe_ux2_edge_color_mult
		before_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_before
		after_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_after
	}
	flatmap_gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = @oe_ux2_zoom_flatmap_far
		gradient_alpha_inside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_inside
		gradient_alpha_outside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_outside
		gradient_width = @oe_ux2_far_width
		gradient_color_mult = @oe_ux2_flat_color_mult
		edge_width = @oe_ux2_far_edge_width
		edge_sharpness = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_sharpness
		edge_alpha = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_alpha
		edge_color_mult = @oe_ux2_edge_color_mult
		before_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_before
		after_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_after
	}

	refresh_colors_on_selection_change = no
	color_refresh_counters = { Month }
	color_and_names_refresh_counters = { LocationOwnerChanged CountryStatus }
}

# 2. Imperial Control, Secretariats & Theme Supply
oe_ux2_mm_imperial_control = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/map_modes/control.dds"
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { is_subject = yes } }
				if = { limit = { local_control >= 0.65 } value = define:NMapColors|WORK_OF_ART_QUALITY_8 }
				else = { value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_INDIRECT_SUBJECT_COLOR }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { local_control >= 0.75 } value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH }
				else_if = { limit = { local_control >= 0.40 } value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MID }
				else = { value = define:NMapColors|WORK_OF_ART_QUALITY_1 }
			}
		}
		else = { value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_OUT_OF_RANGE_COLOR }
	}
	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_ux2_is_imperial_admin_location_trigger = yes }
			value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_CLAIM_SECOND_COLOR
		}
	}
	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_ux2_is_imperial_admin_location_trigger = yes }
			value = OE_UX2_MM2_TT_ADMIN
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_subject = yes } }
			value = OE_UX2_MM2_TT_SUBJ
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes local_control >= 0.75 }
			value = OE_UX2_MM2_TT_HIGH
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes local_control >= 0.40 }
			value = OE_UX2_MM2_TT_MID
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			value = OE_UX2_MM2_TT_LOW
		}
		else = { value = OE_UX2_MM2_TT_UNOWNED }
	}

	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM2_HIGH" color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM2_MID" color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MID }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM2_LOW" color = define:NMapColors|WORK_OF_ART_QUALITY_1 }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM2_SUBJ_HIGH" color = define:NMapColors|WORK_OF_ART_QUALITY_8 }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM2_SUBJ_LOW" color = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_INDIRECT_SUBJECT_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM2_ADMIN" color = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_CLAIM_SECOND_COLOR }

	small_map_names = location_control
	medium_map_names = location_control
	large_map_names = country

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = country

	flatmap_behaviour = Always
	use_fow = no
	enable_rivers = yes

	category = government
	index = 3

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = @oe_ux2_zoom_near
		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = @oe_ux2_far_width
		gradient_color_mult = @oe_ux2_flat_color_mult
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_sharpness
		edge_alpha = 0
		edge_color_mult = 0
		before_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_before
		after_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_after
	}
	flatmap_gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = @oe_ux2_zoom_flatmap
		gradient_alpha_inside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_inside
		gradient_alpha_outside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_outside
		gradient_width = @oe_ux2_flat_width
		gradient_color_mult = @oe_ux2_flat_color_mult
		edge_width = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_width
		edge_sharpness = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_sharpness
		edge_alpha = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_alpha
		edge_color_mult = @oe_ux2_edge_color_mult
		before_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_before
		after_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_after
	}
	flatmap_gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = @oe_ux2_zoom_flatmap_far
		gradient_alpha_inside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_inside
		gradient_alpha_outside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_outside
		gradient_width = @oe_ux2_far_width
		gradient_color_mult = @oe_ux2_flat_color_mult
		edge_width = @oe_ux2_far_edge_width
		edge_sharpness = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_sharpness
		edge_alpha = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_alpha
		edge_color_mult = @oe_ux2_edge_color_mult
		before_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_before
		after_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_after
	}

	refresh_colors_on_selection_change = no
	color_refresh_counters = { Month LocationControlChanged }
	color_and_names_refresh_counters = { LocationOwnerChanged CountryStatus }

# 3. Imperial Roads, Steam Railways & Grand Canals
oe_ux2_mm_corridors_rail = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/map_modes/roads.dds"
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_ux2_is_canal_node_location_trigger = yes }
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_TOP
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_ux2_is_rail_hub_location_trigger = yes }
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_ANTAGONISM_RISK
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { num_roads >= 3 }
			value = define:NMapColors|BUILD_ROAD_HAS_TOP_LEVEL_ROAD
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_road_to_capital = yes }
			value = define:NMapColors|BUILD_ROAD_CAN_BUILD_ROAD
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { num_roads >= 1 }
			value = define:NMapColors|BUILD_ROAD_HAS_OUTDATED_LEVEL_ROAD
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_road_constructions = yes }
			value = define:NMapColors|BUILD_ROAD_IN_PROGRESS
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_ANTAGONISM_NO_RISK
		}
		else = { value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_OUT_OF_RANGE_COLOR }
	}
	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				is_capital = yes
				num_roads >= 1
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_PROXIMITY_BUILDING
		}
	}
	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_ux2_is_canal_node_location_trigger = yes }
			value = OE_UX2_MM3_TT_CANAL
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_ux2_is_rail_hub_location_trigger = yes }
			value = OE_UX2_MM3_TT_RAIL
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { num_roads >= 3 }
			value = OE_UX2_MM3_TT_HUB
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_road_to_capital = yes }
			value = OE_UX2_MM3_TT_CAPROAD
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { num_roads >= 1 }
			value = OE_UX2_MM3_TT_LOCAL
		}
		else = { value = OE_UX2_MM3_TT_NONE }
	}

	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM3_CANAL" color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_TOP }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM3_RAIL" color = define:NMapColors|MAP_ANTAGONISM_RISK }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM3_HUB" color = define:NMapColors|BUILD_ROAD_HAS_TOP_LEVEL_ROAD }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM3_CAPROAD" color = define:NMapColors|BUILD_ROAD_CAN_BUILD_ROAD }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM3_LOCAL" color = define:NMapColors|BUILD_ROAD_HAS_OUTDATED_LEVEL_ROAD }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM3_BUILD" color = define:NMapColors|BUILD_ROAD_IN_PROGRESS }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM3_NONE" color = define:NMapColors|MAP_ANTAGONISM_NO_RISK }

	small_map_names = location
	medium_map_names = country
	large_map_names = country

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = location

	flatmap_behaviour = Always
	use_fow = no
	enable_rivers = yes
	show_roads_faraway = yes

	category = economy
	index = 3

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = @oe_ux2_zoom_near
		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = @oe_ux2_far_width
		gradient_color_mult = @oe_ux2_flat_color_mult
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_sharpness
		edge_alpha = 0
		edge_color_mult = 0
		before_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_before
		after_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_after
	}
	flatmap_gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = @oe_ux2_zoom_flatmap
		gradient_alpha_inside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_inside
		gradient_alpha_outside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_outside
		gradient_width = @oe_ux2_flat_width
		gradient_color_mult = @oe_ux2_flat_color_mult
		edge_width = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_width
		edge_sharpness = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_sharpness
		edge_alpha = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_alpha
		edge_color_mult = @oe_ux2_edge_color_mult
		before_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_before
		after_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_after
	}
	flatmap_gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = @oe_ux2_zoom_flatmap_far
		gradient_alpha_inside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_inside
		gradient_alpha_outside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_outside
		gradient_width = @oe_ux2_far_width
		gradient_color_mult = @oe_ux2_flat_color_mult
		edge_width = @oe_ux2_far_edge_width
		edge_sharpness = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_sharpness
		edge_alpha = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_alpha
		edge_color_mult = @oe_ux2_edge_color_mult
		before_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_before
		after_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_after

# 4. Little Ice Age Winter & Famine/Epidemic Risk
oe_ux2_mm_climate_famine = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/map_modes/winter.dds"
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_any_disease_present = yes }
			value = define:NMapColors|OFFER_PEACE_RELEASE_NATION_COLOR
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes province = { is_starving = yes } }
			value = define:NMapColors|REBEL_IMMINENT_REVOLT_COLOR
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { area = { has_extended_winter = yes } }
			value = define:NMapColors|NORMAL_WINTER_COLOR
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { winter_level = severe }
			value = define:NMapColors|MILD_WINTER_COLOR
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes province = { province_food_percentage < 0.25 } }
			value = define:NMapColors|REBEL_READY_UPRISING_COLOR
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { winter_level = normal winter_level = mild } }
			value = define:NMapColors|INTERNATIONAL_ORGANIZATION_TIER2_COLOR
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_OWNED_PROVINCE_COLOR
		}
		else = { value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_OUT_OF_RANGE_COLOR }
	}
	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				OR = {
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = granary
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = fortress_granary
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = village_granary
				}
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|GOODS_PRICE_DIFFERENCE_GOLD
		}
	}
	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_any_disease_present = yes }
			value = OE_UX2_MM4_TT_DISEASE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes province = { is_starving = yes } }
			value = OE_UX2_MM4_TT_STARVING
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { area = { has_extended_winter = yes } }
			value = OE_UX2_MM4_TT_EXTWINTER
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { winter_level = severe }
			value = OE_UX2_MM4_TT_SEVWINTER
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes province = { province_food_percentage < 0.25 } }
			value = OE_UX2_MM4_TT_LOWFOOD
		}
		else = { value = OE_UX2_MM4_TT_STABLE }
	}

	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM4_DISEASE" color = define:NMapColors|OFFER_PEACE_RELEASE_NATION_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM4_STARVING" color = define:NMapColors|REBEL_IMMINENT_REVOLT_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM4_EXTWINTER" color = define:NMapColors|NORMAL_WINTER_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM4_SEVWINTER" color = define:NMapColors|MILD_WINTER_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM4_LOWFOOD" color = define:NMapColors|REBEL_READY_UPRISING_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM4_MILD" color = define:NMapColors|INTERNATIONAL_ORGANIZATION_TIER2_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM4_STABLE" color = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_OWNED_PROVINCE_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM4_GRANARY" color = define:NMapColors|GOODS_PRICE_DIFFERENCE_GOLD }

	small_map_names = location
	medium_map_names = country
	large_map_names = country

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = location

	flatmap_behaviour = Always
	use_fow = no
	enable_snow = yes

	category = geography
	index = 3

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = @oe_ux2_zoom_near
		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = @oe_ux2_far_width
		gradient_color_mult = @oe_ux2_flat_color_mult
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_sharpness
		edge_alpha = 0
		edge_color_mult = 0
		before_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_before
		after_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_after
	}
	flatmap_gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = @oe_ux2_zoom_flatmap
		gradient_alpha_inside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_inside
		gradient_alpha_outside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_outside
		gradient_width = @oe_ux2_flat_width
		gradient_color_mult = @oe_ux2_flat_color_mult
		edge_width = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_width
		edge_sharpness = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_sharpness
		edge_alpha = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_alpha
		edge_color_mult = @oe_ux2_edge_color_mult
		before_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_before
		after_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_after
	}
	flatmap_gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = @oe_ux2_zoom_flatmap_far
		gradient_alpha_inside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_inside
		gradient_alpha_outside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_outside
		gradient_width = @oe_ux2_far_width
		gradient_color_mult = @oe_ux2_flat_color_mult
		edge_width = @oe_ux2_far_edge_width
		edge_sharpness = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_sharpness
		edge_alpha = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_alpha
		edge_color_mult = @oe_ux2_edge_color_mult
		before_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_before
		after_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_after
	}

	refresh_colors_on_selection_change = no
	color_refresh_counters = { Month Winter LocationWeatherChanged LocationDiseaseChanged }
	color_and_names_refresh_counters = { LocationOwnerChanged CountryStatus }
}

# 5. Great Suzerain Spheres & Tributary Blocs
oe_ux2_mm_suzerain_realms = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/map_modes/diplomacy.dds"
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						OR = {
							AND = { is_human = yes oe_ux2_is_great_suzerain_trigger = yes }
							AND = { is_subject = yes top_overlord ?= { is_human = yes } }
						}
					}
				}
				value = define:NMapColors|HRE_EMPEROR_COLOR
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { oe_ux2_in_roman_sphere_trigger = yes } }
				value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_GUARANTEE_COLOR
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { oe_ux2_in_celestial_sphere_trigger = yes } }
				value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MID
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { oe_ux2_in_western_sphere_trigger = yes } }
				value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_ALLIANCE_COLOR
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { oe_ux2_in_steppe_islamic_sphere_trigger = yes } }
				value = define:NMapColors|WORK_OF_ART_QUALITY_5
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { oe_ux2_in_northern_sphere_trigger = yes } }
				value = define:NMapColors|WORK_OF_ART_QUALITY_8
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						OR = {
							AND = { oe_ux2_is_great_suzerain_trigger = yes OR = { is_great_power = yes num_subjects >= 3 } }
							AND = { is_subject = yes top_overlord ?= { OR = { is_great_power = yes num_subjects >= 3 } } }
						}
					}
				}
				value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_ROYAL_MARRIAGE_COLOR
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { OR = { oe_ux2_is_great_suzerain_trigger = yes is_subject = yes } } }
				value = define:NMapColors|GOODS_PRICE_DIFFERENCE_COPPER
			}
			else = { value = define:NMapColors|MAP_ANTAGONISM_NO_RISK }
		}
		else = { value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_OUT_OF_RANGE_COLOR }
	}
	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_subject = yes } }
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_PROXIMITY_BUILDING
		}
	}
	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_subject = yes } }
			value = OE_UX2_MM5_TT_SUBJECT
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_ux2_is_great_suzerain_trigger = yes } }
			value = OE_UX2_MM5_TT_OVERLORD
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			value = OE_UX2_MM5_TT_INDEP
		}
		else = { value = OE_UX2_MM5_TT_UNOWNED }
	}

	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM5_PLAYER" color = define:NMapColors|HRE_EMPEROR_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM5_ROME" color = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_GUARANTEE_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM5_CELESTIAL" color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MID }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM5_WESTERN" color = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_ALLIANCE_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM5_STEPPE" color = define:NMapColors|WORK_OF_ART_QUALITY_5 }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM5_NORTH" color = define:NMapColors|WORK_OF_ART_QUALITY_8 }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM5_MAJOR" color = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_ROYAL_MARRIAGE_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM5_REGIONAL" color = define:NMapColors|GOODS_PRICE_DIFFERENCE_COPPER }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM5_SUBJECT" color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_PROXIMITY_BUILDING }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM5_INDEP" color = define:NMapColors|MAP_ANTAGONISM_NO_RISK }

	small_map_names = location
	medium_map_names = country
	large_map_names = overlord

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = country

	flatmap_behaviour = Always
	use_fow = no

	category = diplomacy
	index = 3

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = @oe_ux2_zoom_near
		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = @oe_ux2_far_width
		gradient_color_mult = @oe_ux2_flat_color_mult
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_sharpness
		edge_alpha = 0
		edge_color_mult = 0
		before_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_before
		after_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_after
	}
	flatmap_gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = @oe_ux2_zoom_flatmap
		gradient_alpha_inside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_inside
		gradient_alpha_outside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_outside
		gradient_width = @oe_ux2_flat_width
		gradient_color_mult = @oe_ux2_flat_color_mult
		edge_width = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_width
		edge_sharpness = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_sharpness
		edge_alpha = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_alpha
		edge_color_mult = @oe_ux2_edge_color_mult
		before_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_before
		after_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_after
	}
	flatmap_gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = @oe_ux2_zoom_flatmap_far
		gradient_alpha_inside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_inside
		gradient_alpha_outside = @oe_ux2_flat_alpha_outside
		gradient_width = @oe_ux2_far_width
		gradient_color_mult = @oe_ux2_flat_color_mult
		edge_width = @oe_ux2_far_edge_width
		edge_sharpness = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_sharpness
		edge_alpha = @oe_ux2_flat_edge_alpha
		edge_color_mult = @oe_ux2_edge_color_mult
		before_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_before
		after_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_after
	}

	refresh_colors_on_selection_change = no
	color_refresh_counters = { Month DiplomacyChanged RelationStatus }
	color_and_names_refresh_counters = { LocationOwnerChanged CountryStatus }
}

# 6. Civilization Parliaments & Great IOs
oe_ux2_mm_civ_parliaments = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/map_modes/government.dds"
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
					owner = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
				}
				value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_GUARANTEE_COLOR
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
					owner = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom }
				}
				value = define:NMapColors|HRE_EMPEROR_COLOR
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					exists = international_organization:hre
					owner = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:hre }
				}
				value = define:NMapColors|GOODS_PRICE_DIFFERENCE_COPPER
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					exists = international_organization:tatar_yoke
					owner = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:tatar_yoke }
				}
				value = define:NMapColors|WORK_OF_ART_QUALITY_8
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					exists = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
					owner = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate }
				}
				value = define:NMapColors|WORK_OF_ART_QUALITY_1
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
					owner = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
				}
				value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_ALLIANCE_COLOR
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_parliament = yes } }
				value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
			}
			else = { value = define:NMapColors|MAP_ANTAGONISM_NO_RISK }
		}
		else = { value = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_OUT_OF_RANGE_COLOR }
	}
	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { has_ongoing_parliament_debate = yes } }
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_PROXIMITY_BUILDING
		}
	}
	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
				owner = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
			}
			value = OE_UX2_MM6_TT_PILLARS
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
				owner = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom }
			}
			value = OE_UX2_MM6_TT_MK
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				exists = international_organization:hre
				owner = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:hre }
			}
			value = OE_UX2_MM6_TT_HRE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				exists = international_organization:tatar_yoke
				owner = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:tatar_yoke }
			}
			value = OE_UX2_MM6_TT_TATAR
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				exists = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
				owner = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate }
			}
			value = OE_UX2_MM6_TT_SHOGUN
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
				owner = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
			}
			value = OE_UX2_MM6_TT_CONCERT
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { has_parliament = yes } }
			value = OE_UX2_MM6_TT_PARL
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			value = OE_UX2_MM6_TT_OTHER
		}
		else = { value = OE_UX2_MM6_TT_UNOWNED }
	}

	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM6_PILLARS" color = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_GUARANTEE_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM6_MK" color = define:NMapColors|HRE_EMPEROR_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM6_HRE" color = define:NMapColors|GOODS_PRICE_DIFFERENCE_COPPER }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM6_TATAR" color = define:NMapColors|WORK_OF_ART_QUALITY_8 }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM6_SHOGUN" color = define:NMapColors|WORK_OF_ART_QUALITY_1 }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM6_CONCERT" color = define:NMapColors|DIPLOMACY_ALLIANCE_COLOR }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM6_PARL" color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM6_DEBATE" color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_PROXIMITY_BUILDING }
	legend_key = { desc = "LEGEND_KEY_OE_UX2_MM6_OTHER" color = define:NMapColors|MAP_ANTAGONISM_NO_RISK }

		edge_alpha = 0

		after_lighting_blend = @oe_ux2_flat_after
